intro.summary: Small northwest community on the Bow River near Foothills Medical Centre, where older bungalows give way to larger single-detached and semi-detached infills.
intro.body: Parkdale lies along the north bank of the Bow River and Parkdale Boulevard, close to Foothills Medical Centre, the University of Calgary and the river pathways. Its mid-century bungalows are often replaced by larger two-storey single-detached homes or semi-detached pairs.
